arxiv-2010-15095.title: Diffusive coupling of two well-mixed compartments elucidates elementary principles of protein-based pattern formation
arxiv-2010-15095.creator: Fridtjof Brauns, Jacob Halatek, Erwin Frey
arxiv-2010-15095.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Fridtjof Brauns, Jacob Halatek, Erwin Frey. Spatial organization of proteins in cells is important for many biological functions. In general, the nonlinear, spatially coupled models for protein-pattern formation are only accessible to numerical simulations, which has limited insight into the general underlying principles. To overcome this limitation, we adopt the setting of two diffusively coupled, well-mixed compartments that represents the elementary feature of any pattern—an interface. For intracellular systems, the total numbers of proteins are conserved on the relevant timescale of pattern formation.

arxiv-2012-13745.title: Quantum-Enhanced Two-Photon Spectroscopy Using Two-mode Squeezed Light
arxiv-2012-13745.creator: Nikunjkumar Prajapati, Ziqi Niu, Irina Novikova
arxiv-2012-13745.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Nikunjkumar Prajapati, Ziqi Niu, Irina Novikova. We investigate the prospects of using two-mode intensity squeezed twin-beams, generated in Rb vapor, to improve the sensitivity of spectroscopic measurements by engaging two-photon Raman transitions. As a proof of principle demonstration, we demonstrated the quantum-enhanced measurements of the Rb 5 ​ D 3 / 2 5D_{3/2} hyperfine structure with reduced requirements for the Raman pump laser power and Rb vapor number density.

arxiv-2106-15521.title: Locally correct confidence intervals for a binomial proportion: A new criteria for an interval estimator
arxiv-2106-15521.creator: Paul H. Garthwaite, Maha W. Moustafa, Fadlalla G. Elfadaly
arxiv-2106-15521.description: Abstract Well-recommended methods of forming ‘confidence intervals’ for a binomial proportion give interval estimates that do not actually meet the definition of a confidence interval, in that their coverages are sometimes lower than the nominal confidence level. The methods are favoured because their intervals have a shorter average length than the Clopper-Pearson (gold-standard) method, whose intervals really are confidence intervals.

arxiv-2305-11326.title: Automatic Generation of Conversational Interfaces for Tabular Data Analysis Conference: ACM Conversational User Interfaces 2024; July 8–10, 2024; Luxembourg, Luxembourg ACM Conversational User Interfaces 2024 (CUI ’24), July 8–10, 2024, Luxembourg, Luxembourg DOI: 10.1145/3640794.3665577 ISBN: 979-8
arxiv-2305-11326.creator: Marcos Gomez-Vazquez, Jordi Cabot, Robert Clarisó
arxiv-2305-11326.description: Abstract . Tabular data is the most common format to publish and exchange structured data online. A clear example is the growing number of open data portals published by public administrations. However, exploitation of these data sources is currently limited to technical people able to programmatically manipulate and digest such data.

arxiv-2309-03619.title: Understanding Self-Supervised Learning of Speech Representation via Invariance and Redundancy Reduction
arxiv-2309-03619.creator: Yusuf Brima, Ulf Krumnack, Simone Pika, Gunther Heidemann
arxiv-2309-03619.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yusuf Brima, Ulf Krumnack, Simone Pika, Gunther Heidemann. Self-supervised learning (SSL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for learning flexible speech representations from unlabeled data. By designing pretext tasks that exploit statistical regularities, SSL models can capture useful representations that are transferable to downstream tasks . This study provides an empirical analysis of Barlow Twins (BT), an SSL technique inspired by theories of redundancy reduction in human perception. On downstream tasks, BT representations accelerated learning and transferred across domains.

arxiv-2402-00027.title: Perspectives on locally weighted ensemble Kalman methods
arxiv-2402-00027.creator: Philipp Wacker
arxiv-2402-00027.description: Abstract This manuscript derives locally weighted ensemble Kalman methods from the point of view of ensemble-based function approximation. This is done by using pointwise evaluations to build up a local linear or quadratic approximation of a function, tapering off the effect of distant particles via local weighting.

arxiv-2403-05317.title: Extreme wave skewing and dispersion spectra of anisotropic elastic plates
arxiv-2403-05317.creator: Daniel A. Kiefer, Sylvain Mezil, Claire Prada
arxiv-2403-05317.description: Abstract Guided wave dispersion is commonly assessed by Fourier analysis of the field along a line, resulting in frequency-wavenumber dispersion curves. In anisotropic plates, a point source can generate multiple dispersion branches pertaining to the same modal surface, which arise due to the angle between the power flux and the wave vector.

arxiv-2411-12828.title: Probing the Capacity of Language Model Agents to Operationalize Disparate Experiential Context Despite Distraction
arxiv-2411-12828.creator: Sonny George, Chris Sypherd, Dylan Cashman
arxiv-2411-12828.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sonny George, Chris Sypherd, Dylan Cashman. Large language model (LLM) agents show promise in an increasing number of domains. In many proposed applications, it is expected that the agent reasons over accumulated experience presented in an input prompt. We propose the OEDD (Operationalize Experience Despite Distraction) corpus, a human-annotator-validated body of scenarios with pre-scripted agent histories where the agent must make a decision based on disparate experiential information in the presence of a distractor.

arxiv-2412-16579.title: A generalisation of bent vectors for Butson Hadamard matrices
arxiv-2412-16579.creator: J. A. Armario, R. Egan, H. Kharaghani, P. Ó Catháin
arxiv-2412-16579.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by J. A. Armario, R. Egan, H. Kharaghani, P. Ó Catháin. An n × n n\times n complex matrix M M with entries in the k th k^{\textrm{th}} roots of unity which satisfies M ​ M ∗ = n ​ I n MM^{\ast}=nI_{n} is called a Butson Hadamard matrix. While a matrix with entries in the k th k^{\textrm{th}} roots typically does not have an eigenvector with entries in the same set, such vectors and their generalisations turn out to have multiple applications.

arxiv-2501-14275.title: Leveraging Online Olympiad-Level Math Problems for LLMs Training and Contamination-Resistant Evaluation
arxiv-2501-14275.creator: Sadegh Mahdavi, Muchen Li, Kaiwen Liu, Christos Thrampoulidis, Leonid Sigal, Renjie Liao
arxiv-2501-14275.description: Abstract Advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have sparked interest in their ability to solve Olympiad-level math problems. However, the training and evaluation of these models are constrained by the limited size and quality of available datasets, as creating large-scale data for such advanced problems requires extensive effort from human experts.

arxiv-2510-23073.title: Multiscale modeling for contact problem with high-contrast heterogeneous coefficients with primary-dual formulation
arxiv-2510-23073.creator: Zishang Li, Changqing Ye, Eric T. Chung
arxiv-2510-23073.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a novel iterative multiscale framework for solving high-contrast contact problems of Signorini type. The method integrates the constrained energy minimizing generalized multiscale finite element method (CEM-GMsFEM) with a primal-dual active set strategy derived from semismooth Newton methods.

pmc-10700187.title: Nano‐Plumber Reshapes Glymphatic‐Lymphatic System to Sustain Microenvironment Homeostasis and Improve Long‐Term Prognosis after Traumatic Brain Injury
pmc-10700187.creator: Shiqiang Tong, Laozhi Xie, Xiaoying Xie, Jianpei Xu, Yang You, Yinzhe Sun, Songlei Zhou, Chuchu Ma, Gan Jiang, Fenfen Ma, Zhihua Wang, Xiaoling Gao, Jun Chen
pmc-10700187.description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide. Long‐term changes in the microenvironment of the brain contribute to the degeneration of neurological function following TBI. However, current research focuses primarily on short‐term modulation during the early phases of TBI, not on the critical significance of long‐term homeostasis in the brain microenvironment.

pmc-11671769.title: Efficacy of Supratherapeutic Duloxetine Combined With Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy in Severe Treatment-Resistant Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder With Comorbid Depression: A Case Report
pmc-11671769.creator: Syed Ali Bokhari, Mohamed H Nasr, Yasmeen T Alawadhi
pmc-11671769.description: This case report discusses the treatment of a 42-year-old male with over a decade of treatment-resistant obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and comorbid major depressive disorder (MDD). The patient underwent various pharmacological and psychotherapeutic treatments, including multiple antidepressants and cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), yet experienced only partial symptom relief.

pmc-13106117.creator: David Hochstein, Yona Rothé, Avshalom Shaffer, Yisrael Parmet, Oliana Vazhgovsky, Hanita Shai, Alona Raucher, Racheli Sion Sarid, Erica Pollak, Dor Freidin, Lior Sasson, Yishai Salem, Uriel Katz, Sagi Asa, Netanel Nagar, Shai Tejman-Yarden, Sharon Borik Chiger
pmc-13106117.description: BackgroundRight ventricle-to-pulmonary artery (RV–PA) conduits are crucial to establishing or restoring RV–PA continuity in children with complex congenital heart disease. One of the major procedural concerns in these cases is the risk of coronary artery compression during stent implantation.
